name: Konno Miyako
source:
A girl who belonged to the same special course as Shirasaki, but stopped attending school because she couldn't stand being bullied.

She was rumored to have gone missing after trying out an urban legend, but one day she suddenly started coming to school without anything happening.

She seems so cheerful and positive that it is hard to believe that she was bullied, but she also has a somewhat dark and idealistic view of things.

[Translated from [url=https://lupinuspalette-gam.wixsite.com/my-site?pgid=kv5kbz8l-4b114a01-f80a-44f4-8ba5-d6297b207a96]official website[/url]]
